description: Makes a picture from a prompt, optionally following reference pictures, and returns a job; when it is done the result links the picture and a small one is shown inline. Spends the account's credits per picture (ugcfans_list_models gives each model's price). Call ugcfans_estimate first and pass its quote; without a quote this returns the cost and makes nothing.

aspect_ratio.description: The frame, such as 1:1, 9:16 or 16:9, when the model offers it.

quote.description: The quote from ugcfans_estimate for exactly this request. Without it the call returns the estimate and makes nothing.

reference.description: Pictures of the subject or style to follow: addresses of library files, out/...

resolution.description: The resolution, such as 1K, when the model offers it.

name: ugcfans_make_image
title: Make an image
